meta.name: animate-image
meta.description: Animate an existing product image or static ad into a short branded video using the GooseWorks Animate Images workflow, with source-image continuity and optional end-frame control.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品图或静态广告变成一条带品牌感的短视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有产品图想快速做成短视频用于营销。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product image or static ad into a short branded video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have product images and need quick marketing videos.

howto.what: 将现有产品图或静态广告转为短视频，保留产品形状、logo、包装和图上文字，支持以原图为起始帧或结束帧。会先估算点数并确认，再提交任务、轮询结果，最后给出视频链接和所用源图。
howto.when: 当用户提供产品图或广告图并要求生成动画视频，且 GooseWorks MCP 工具可用时触发。

say.text: 把这张产品图做成 5 秒的品牌视频
say.note: 将调用动画工作流生成视频

say.text: 用这张图作为起始帧，镜头缓慢推进，保持包装不变
say.note: 运动提示会注明镜头推进和不变要素

say.text: 给这张广告图加上轻微漂浮的动态效果

howto.what_en: Turns an existing product image or static ad into a short video, preserving product shape, logo, packaging, and on-image copy. Optionally uses source as start/end frame. Estimates credits, submits once, polls, returns video URL and source image.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a product or ad image and asks to animate it, as long as the GooseWorks MCP tools are available.

say_en.text: Turn this product image into a 5-second brand video.
Use this image as the start frame, slowly push in, keep packaging unchanged.
say_en.note: Motion prompt includes camera move and unchanged elements.

say_en.text: Add a subtle floating motion to this ad image.
